topic: Phase 2 / Nguya FLNG start-up and feed fields
wiki_text: Eni launched start-up of Phase 2 of the Congo LNG project on 2 December 2025, ahead of schedule (~35 months after construction of the Nguya FLNG began). The first LNG cargo from Phase 2 loaded on 7 February 2026 at Pointe-Noire, attended by Congo President Denis Sassou N'Guesso and Eni CEO Claudio Descalzi. The Nguya FLNG (376 m long x 60 m wide; 2.4 mtpa) liquefies gas from the Nene and Litchendjili fields in the offshore Marine XII license, processed via the Scarabeo 5 treatment/compression unit and three production platforms. Together with the 0.6 mtpa Tango FLNG (Congo FLNG Terminal, Phase 1, operating since December 2023), the Congo LNG project reaches a total liquefaction capacity of 3 mtpa (4.5 bcm/y).
